name: Skeptic
reason: Satellite index is low and falling fast, temperatures are cool with zero hot days, so the 0.667 historical October rate looks like a base rate being asked to do too much work.
evidence: cyano_index 0.025 with change_vs_last_week -0.039, so the signal is low and dropping
max_temp_avg 18.8 C with hot_days 0, which is weak support for growth
rain_last_14d_mm 1.4 and heavy_rain_days 0, so little nutrient runoff to fuel a new surge
bloom_rate_this_month_past_years 0.667 is the one real point for a bloom, but it is only a prior and the current data pulls against it
